comment: Read from src/Seethe.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. Every Mix knob defaults to 0, which is fully dry, so a new instance passes its input through without any saturation until one of them is turned up; nothing on the panel says so. The Curve controls are doubled up: Seethe.cpp:274 uses the value as the tension of the waveshaper and Seethe.cpp:275 uses the same value to set the band's filter frequency, two octaves either side of 450Hz, 850Hz and 1500Hz, so the crossover moves with the tone. The three curves the Morph knob crossfades are built at Seethe.cpp:198 to 200 as a symmetrical sigmoid, a full-wave rectified sigmoid and a sine fold; a half-wave curve is written in the file but never used. Each band output is high-passed at 15.2Hz to take out the offset the rectifying curves create. The module has no right-click menu of its own, so no panel-colour choice, and there is no manual or README entry for it.
